name: After the Ambush
summary: Dark Iron dwarves have broken the powder run to Loch Modan’s southern excavation site. Huldar stays behind with the remaining barrels while Miran prepares to carry the next load forward with an escort.

sections.title: A Fractured Supply Line
sections.body: Huldar and Miran’s powder run through Loch Modan has turned dangerous. After Saean and his conspirators led an ambush, barrels lay scattered and the road became perilous. The two haulers divide their duties: Huldar guards what remains, while Miran prepares to move ahead with the next load.

sections.title: The Road to the Dig
sections.body: Loch Modan’s excavation sites need blasting powder to break stone and uncover titan relics. Miran fears another ambush from the ridges along the path. Before loading his cargo, he seeks a companion to travel with him past any traps the Dark Irons may have prepared.

faq.answer: Huldar and Miran are dwarven haulers carrying heavy barrels of blasting powder across Loch Modan for local excavations.

faq.q: Why can't Huldar and Miran travel together?
faq.answer: After an ambush left the shipment vulnerable, Huldar stayed behind to guard the remaining barrels while Miran moved ahead with the first batch.
Hostile Dark Iron dwarves led by Saean ambushed the haulers, seeking to disrupt Alliance operations and seize or destroy their mining explosives.

faq.q: Where is Miran taking the powder?
faq.answer: Miran is taking the barrels to Loch Modan’s southern excavation site, where Prospector Ironband’s team needs blasting powder to clear rock and uncover buried ruins.

faq.q: Why is blasting powder so heavily guarded in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League needs blasting powder for its excavations, but the explosives are dangerous in the wrong hands. Dark Iron infiltrators across the region seek to sabotage supplies and weaken Ironforge’s hold on the territory.

faq.q: What happens after talking to Miran?
faq.answer: After checking the wagon and cargo, Miran asks you to escort him along the road so the shipment reaches the excavation site intact.

angles.text: As a dwarf, protecting Ironforge’s supplies from Dark Iron saboteurs helps keep your homeland’s mountain passes and mining operations safe.
As an Alliance member, keeping supplies moving in Loch Modan helps the League’s research continue and keeps the southern passes under Alliance control.
As a miner, you know blasting powder drives deep underground digs, so protecting these barrels matters to any serious mining venture.
